public_body: Fall River City Council Subcommittee On Economic Development And Tourism
overall: The AG found the Subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law on both allegations: the notice was not specific enough about the consultants' presentation, and the Subcommittee responded late to a prior complaint. Only a reminder was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Nov. 29, 2016 notice omitted a topic for a consultants' presentation and that an unlisted topic was discussed at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the November 29 meeting notice was not sufficiently detailed because the notice only advised the public that Mr. Mellion would be speaking about the branding initiative and the Subcommittee reasonably anticipated the power-point presentation by EGN Consultants and Figmints Delicious Designs to occur that evening.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Subcommittee failed to respond to an earlier Open Meeting Law complaint within the 14 business days required by law.
allegations.key_passage: The Subcommittee responded by letter dated January 9, 2017 to an Open Meeting Law complaint filed with the Subcommittee on December 13, 2016

remedy: Reminder of the Subcommittee's obligations under the Open Meeting Law; no additional relief ordered
remedy_passage: We take this opportunity to remind the Subcommittee of its obligations under the Open Meeting Law, and order no additional relief.
